name: FuckDaHaters
funnelNote: TikTok/IG → streams → killscomfort.com/book. Every post supports listens and bookings.

tasks.task: Pick your release date — a Friday, 5 weeks out. Write it everywhere. This is now your countdown anchor.
Upload 'FuckDaHaters' to DistroKid. Final master, artwork (3000×3000), metadata. Set the release date. Use killscomfort.com/book as your artist website URL.

Open Spotify for Artists and pitch 'FuckDaHaters' using the upcoming release tool. Describe the mood, BPM, subgenre, and that you're a performing DJ in the your city scene. This must happen 3–4 weeks before release.
Update your Spotify for Artists bio to mention DJ bookings and link to killscomfort.com/book. Update your profile photo if it's outdated.
Create your HyperFollow pre-save page for 'FuckDaHaters'. Customize it — add your booking site link. Test it on mobile.
Update Instagram bio: 'killscomfort · DJ · your city · New track [date] · Book me' — link goes to killscomfort.com/book (NOT the homepage).
Update TikTok bio the same way. If you don't have TikTok yet, create @killscomfort now. Bio links to booking. This is your #1 discovery platform.
Upload a 60-second preview of 'FuckDaHaters' to SoundCloud. Description includes booking link and 'available for DJ sets in your city and beyond.'
FILM DAY. Record 6–8 short clips: DAW screen recordings of the drop, you vibing to the track on monitors, a reaction shot, the track in car speakers. Raw material for 3 weeks of content.
Join or re-engage in 2–3 communities: r/EDM, a your city music Discord, a local DJ Facebook group. Comment on 10 posts. No promo — just be present.
Map out your content calendar for weeks 2–5. Batch-edit 3–4 video clips so they're ready to post Monday. Pre-write captions.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.subtitle: The track name IS the content — lean into the attitude

tasks.task: TikTok/Reel #1: 10-sec DAW screen recording of the hardest drop. Caption: 'made a track called FuckDaHaters. should I drop it or keep it for sets?'
30-min engagement session: comment genuinely on 15+ posts from your city venues, EDM creators, and local promoters. Get seen by their audiences. Don't self-promote.
TikTok/Reel #2: 'POV: the track you made after someone said you'd never make it' — play 'FuckDaHaters' over a moody studio shot or your city night visual.
Reply to every comment from posts #1 and #2. Follow back anyone who engages. Spend 15 min in communities. DM anyone who says something like 'drop this.'
TikTok/Reel #3: the track playing through car speakers cruising your city. 8–12 seconds, loop-friendly. Caption: 'miami nights + unreleased heat · booking link in bio.'
Attend a local event, even a small one. Post a story of the crowd/venue, tag the venue and DJ. Build your local network IRL — this is where bookings come from.
Analytics review: which post got the most views, saves, and shares? What time performed best? Check killscomfort.com/book for social traffic. Adjust Week 3 plan.

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.subtitle: Position yourself as a DJ who books, not just a producer who posts

tasks.task: TikTok/Reel #4: production timelapse of 'FuckDaHaters' session condensed to 15 sec. End text: 'drops [date] · book me → link in bio.'
DM 5 your city venues, bars, or event promoters. Intro only: 'Hey, I'm killscomfort, I DJ and produce locally. Got a track dropping soon. Love what you do at [venue]. Would love to connect.'
TikTok/Reel #5: use your past event photos. Slow pan across 3–4 event shots set to 'FuckDaHaters' with text: 'this is what a killscomfort set looks like.' CTA to booking page.
Build your playlist submission list: search Spotify for 30–50 playlists in your subgenre (500–10K followers). Save curator names/IG handles in a spreadsheet.
Instagram Story series: the story behind 'FuckDaHaters.' What inspired the name, the energy, the moment. End slide: 'hear it live → killscomfort.com/book.'
Give production feedback in a community. Share a tip or technique. Build goodwill so when you share your track next week, people care.
Write your playlist pitch: track name, genre, one-line hook, 2 comparison artists, private link. Save it — you'll use this 50+ times.

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.subtitle: Playlist blitz + content that drives to killscomfort.com/book

tasks.task: TikTok/Reel #6: release date reveal. Text overlay with the drop playing: '[DATE]. FuckDaHaters.' Caption drives to pre-save link.
Submit 'FuckDaHaters' to 15 playlists via SubmitHub or direct DM. Use your pitch template. Focus on playlists with 500–10K followers.
Submit to 15 more playlists. Also submit to 3–5 SoundCloud repost channels. Aim for 50 total submissions by end of week.
TikTok/Reel #7: 'rate my unreleased track 1–10' — play 'FuckDaHaters' through studio monitors or your DJ controller. Showing gear = showing you're bookable.
Engagement blitz: 30 min across TikTok + Instagram. Reply to every comment. DM anyone who shared. Drop genuine comments on 15+ posts.
Instagram carousel: 'The making of FuckDaHaters' — 4 slides: inspiration, production, what the name means, final artwork. Last slide: booking CTA.
Follow up on unresponded playlist submissions. Send remaining submissions to hit 50 total. Track which curators responded positively.
Mid-campaign check: Spotify for Artists visibility, pre-save numbers, booking site traffic, follower growth. What's working? Double down.

phases.title: Pre-save push — convert to listeners and site visitors

weeks.label: Week 5
weeks.subtitle: Every post drives to pre-save AND killscomfort.com/book

tasks.task: TikTok/Reel #8: countdown — '5 DAYS. FuckDaHaters.' Catchiest 8 seconds. Caption: 'pre-save in bio. also booking events — your city and beyond.'
Pin a post to your IG grid that's a permanent booking CTA: you DJing + text overlay 'book killscomfort' + caption with killscomfort.com/book link.
Post in every community you've been active in: 'been working on this for months — drops Friday. pre-save means everything.' Personal tone, not spam.
DM the 5 venue contacts from Week 3: 'hey — I have a new track dropping Friday called FuckDaHaters. Would love to celebrate with a set somewhere.'
TikTok/Reel #9: behind-the-scenes of a specific sound design moment in 'FuckDaHaters.' '3 days.' Most replay-worthy loop from the track.
Instagram Stories: countdown sticker, pre-save link sticker, 'book me to DJ' slide with killscomfort.com/book link.
DM your 10–15 most engaged followers personally. Thank them. Share the pre-save. Ask them to share with one friend.
TikTok/Reel #10: 'TOMORROW.' Full energy, best visual, strongest section. Pin to your TikTok profile.
Prep ALL release day content: 2 feed posts, 5+ stories, all captions pre-written, streaming links ready to swap in when the track goes live.
Final checks: pre-save link works, killscomfort.com/book loads on mobile, Spotify for Artists updated, all bios have correct links. Rest up.

phases.title: Release week — maximum visibility to bookings

weeks.label: Week 6
weeks.subtitle: Every interaction funnels to streams AND killscomfort.com/book

tasks.task: RELEASE DAY. TikTok/Reel #11: 'FuckDaHaters is out.' Drop + streaming link in bio. Update ALL bios: swap pre-save for streaming link, keep booking link on top.
Instagram feed post + story barrage (5+ stories): link stickers to streaming platforms. One story: 'want this energy live? → book me' with killscomfort.com/book.
Post in every community. DM everyone who pre-saved. Share on personal accounts. Text friends and family the link. First 48 hours of velocity matter most.
TikTok/Reel #12: reaction content — play 'FuckDaHaters' through speakers, film friends/crowd vibing. Tag your your city location.
Reply to EVERY comment and DM today. Repost anyone who shares. In every reply, weave in that you DJ.
TikTok/Reel #13: mini DJ mix — transition from another track into 'FuckDaHaters.' Shows DJ skill for bookers.
Engagement blitz: 30 min commenting. Share in 2–3 new communities. DM 5 more your city venues/promoters with the track link and booking page.
TikTok/Reel #14: meme format — 'when the drop hits on FuckDaHaters' using your track as a TikTok sound. Make the audio usable by others.
Follow up with playlist curators. Submit to new playlists discovered during release week. Thank every curator who added you.
Full analytics deep dive: Spotify streams/saves/playlist adds, social follower growth, killscomfort.com/book visits, booking inquiries. Document everything.

weeks.label: Weeks 7–8
weeks.subtitle: Don't disappear — this is where most artists drop the ball

tasks.task: Post 2–3 Reels/TikToks per week using 'FuckDaHaters' audio. Remix angles: 'when they said you couldn't,' 'your city at 2am,' 'that one friend who always hated.'
Continue daily engagement: 15 min commenting, replying, building relationships. Consistency separates artists who grow from artists who spike and fade.
Post educational/authority content: 'how to read a room as a DJ,' 'my DJ setup for events,' 'what I learned from my worst set.' Drives booking page traffic.
Reach out to 3 your city DJs or producers for potential collabs. Even a simple Instagram Live together helps.
Post a 'thank you' video: streams, new followers, what's next. Mention upcoming availability for bookings.
Plan your next release. The rollout never truly stops — each track builds on the last. Start the cycle again.
